title: First Foo Fighter reports, November 1944

tellings.quote: anniversary of the first reports of Foo Fighters. Like that happened November of 1944.

plain: The first reports of what came to be called foo fighters, unexplained objects seen in the sky, date to November 1944. A guest named Marik von Rennenkampff mentions this on Michels's show, marking it as the anniversary of those first reports. He brings it up to show how far back such sightings go.
